note:
R48 — PS4 play-by-play: typed event parameters (`0TVE` = little-endian EVT0 'KETT'), which parameters the sentence phrase items consume, and
the sample groups of the name-carrying phrases against the keyword-tagged samples (read-only; NHL 15–21 extracted trees).

`pbp_speecheventsubscr.bin` ('0TVETTEK'): `u32 2 | u32 namespace | u32 n | u32 g | u32 0x28 | u32 0 | u64 ptr -> g x u64 parameter records |
n x u64 event records`. Parameter record: `u32 type (3 = integer, 1 / 2 = enum) | u32 id | u32 enum count | ... | u64 enum ptr @+24 | name @+32`.
Event record (96-byte fixed part): `u64 size (= 4 x count) | u16 count | u16 flag | ... | u16 ns, u16 id @+0x28 | ... | count x u32 param id @+0x60 | name`.
`pbp_sentencedata.bin` ('0CPSTTEK', 2026-09-20 `pbp_sentences.py` layout): variant name = event name; phrase = `u32 type | u32 dsetKey | u32 historyKey
| u64 0 | u32 0 | items`, item = 12 bytes `u8 i | u8 i+1 | u8 i | 0 | 1 | ff | 0 | 0 | u32 tag` where i indexes the event's parameter list.
Outputs per title: the parameter table (id, type, enum count, name), event count and per-parameter event usage, per-parameter phrase-item
usage, and for every phrase whose items reference `surname_ID` / `player_ID` / `team_ID` / `team_home_ID` / `team_away_ID` / `city_ID`:
the sample group (bank, DSET) and how many of its samples are keyword-tagged, by how many distinct keywords, and how many of those keywords
are the DB-bound team / arena keywords. No claim about which DB column supplies the runtime value.
Usage: python r48_ps4_speech_event_params_and_name_phrases.py <out.json> [--titles nhl21,nhl15]
